description: Statement of work -H1 Mixed Hedge - Front RHB: Hedge reduction - To trim back height and garden side only of previous seasons re-growth to create a tight and compact hedge.T2 Buddleia - Rear LHB: To reduce height to approximately 0.5 metres above ground level.G3 Bay and  Rose - Re-shaping: To trim all previous seasons re-growth, and to reduce the Rose by approximately 50%.T4 Apple - Rear LHB: Crown Reduction - To reduce the height and radial spread of the canopy by up to 1.5 metres, maintaining a natural dome shape and remove major deadwood.T5 Apple - Rear garden: Crown Reduction - To reduce the height and radial spread of the canopy by up to 1.5 metres, maintaining a natural shape and remove major deadwood.T6 Plum - Crown Reduction - To reduce the height and radial spread of the canopy by up to 1.5 metres, maintaining a natural shape and remove major deadwood.T7 Philadelphus (Mock Orange) - Towards rear boundary: Crown Reduction - To reduce the height and radial spread of the canopy by up to 1.5 metres, maintaining a natural shape and remove major deadwood.T8 Box Elder - Rear LHB: Crown Reduction - To reduce the height and radial spread of the canopy by up to 2 metres, to shape accordingly and remove major deadwood.T9 Pyracantha - Rear LHB: Crown Reduction - To reduce the overall height and radial spread of the canopy by up to 1 metre maintaining a natural shape. To include cutting back off neighbouring and client's pathways.T10 Holm Oak - Rear RHB neighbouring tree: To cut back canopy overhanging client's garden.T11-T13 Lime - To re-pollard back to previous reduction points.G14 Mixed vegetation - Adjacent to rear of garage: To cut back vegetation to approximately 1 metre away from rear of bench. To include removing the Buddleia growing through the pathing slabs and poison stump to avoid regrowth. To finish off the gardener's cuts on the Buddleia and poison.Reason for work ? General maintenance
